nodes.label: LogonUser batch-then-interactive logon plus impersonation
nodes.rationale: Batch logon keeps a full admin token; credential used in-process, never on a command line or to a child process.

nodes.label: Flow 4.2 Service action with credential fallback
nodes.norm_label: flow 4.2 service action with credential fallback
nodes.rationale: Run with app's elevated token first; on Access is denied retry inside ElevatedServiceRunner.Run using batch logon (not UAC-filtered), falling back to interactive, via WindowsIdentity.RunImpersonated.

nodes.label: DEC-002 Keep Admin Credentials; own token first, LogonUser batch/interactive fallback, no sc.exe
nodes.norm_label: dec-002 keep admin credentials; own token first, logonuser batch/interactive fallback, no sc.exe
nodes.rationale: Own-token-first succeeds whenever the elevated app has rights; the fallback covers restricted services; batch logon avoids UAC filtering; in-process impersonation removes the pipe deadlock and password-to-child-process exposure.

nodes.label: DEF-001 Saving monitored services erases the saved admin credential (High)
nodes.norm_label: def-001 saving monitored services erases the saved admin credential (high)
nodes.rationale: TrayAppContext serialised a stale startup AppSettings over the file; fix: SaveGeneralSettings re-reads and replaces only general fields.

nodes.label: DEF-002 Filter loses checks; Save drops services hidden by the filter (High)
nodes.norm_label: def-002 filter loses checks; save drops services hidden by the filter (high)
nodes.rationale: List rebuilt on every keystroke and Save read only visible CheckedItems; fix: ServiceSelection working set.

nodes.label: DEF-006 UI freezes for up to 15 s during service actions (Medium)
nodes.norm_label: def-006 ui freezes for up to 15 s during service actions (medium)
nodes.rationale: Actions ran synchronously on the UI thread; fix: Task.Run.

nodes.label: DEF-007 Grid loses sort, scroll, and selection on every poll (Medium)
nodes.norm_label: def-007 grid loses sort, scroll, and selection on every poll (medium)
nodes.rationale: Rows cleared and re-added each poll; fix: in-place updates.

nodes.label: DEF-008 Action results differ between direct and credential paths (Medium)
nodes.norm_label: def-008 action results differ between direct and credential paths (medium)
nodes.rationale: sc.exe path reported accepted-pending as success; fix: both paths use ServiceActions.

nodes.label: DEF-009 Overlapping polls, blocking cross-thread Invoke, shared list reference (Medium)
nodes.norm_label: def-009 overlapping polls, blocking cross-thread invoke, shared list reference (medium)
nodes.rationale: Unguarded RefreshNow; fix: serialised refreshes, BeginInvoke, list copy.

nodes.label: DEF-010 Corrupt config.json silently replaced; non-atomic writes (Medium)
nodes.norm_label: def-010 corrupt config.json silently replaced; non-atomic writes (medium)
nodes.rationale: Parse errors swallowed; fix: corrupt-file backup and temp-file atomic save.

nodes.label: DEF-011 Resource leaks (menu items, event handlers, service handles) (Low)
nodes.norm_label: def-011 resource leaks (menu items, event handlers, service handles) (low)
nodes.rationale: Handlers attached per keystroke, undisposed menu items/fonts/ServiceControllers, no unsubscribe on dispose.

nodes.label: DEF-012 Missing services shown red instead of gray; duplicated colour/rule logic (Low)
nodes.norm_label: def-012 missing services shown red instead of gray; duplicated colour/rule logic (low)
nodes.rationale: StatusColor ignored Exists; fix: StatusPalette single source, shared ServiceActionRules.

nodes.label: DEF-014 Build warning WFAC010 (DPI settings in manifest) (Low)
nodes.norm_label: def-014 build warning wfac010 (dpi settings in manifest) (low)
nodes.rationale: DPI settings moved to ApplicationHighDpiMode PerMonitorV2.

nodes.label: DEF-015 Tray updates run on thread-pool threads instead of the UI thread (Medium)
nodes.norm_label: def-015 tray updates run on thread-pool threads instead of the ui thread (medium)
nodes.rationale: SynchronizationContext captured before WinForms installed it; fix: install WindowsFormsSynchronizationContext explicitly.

nodes.label: DEF-016 Cancel keeps unsaved checks; poll interval > 300 crashes the window (Low)
nodes.norm_label: def-016 cancel keeps unsaved checks; poll interval > 300 crashes the window (low)
nodes.rationale: Hidden form kept state; interval not clamped to 2-300.

nodes.label: DEF-017 Re-saving the credential without retyping the password stores an empty password (Medium)
nodes.norm_label: def-017 re-saving the credential without retyping the password stores an empty password (medium)
nodes.rationale: Save encrypted the empty password box; fix: blank password with unchanged login keeps the saved password.

nodes.label: Troubleshooting Access is denied: batch logon and full admin token
nodes.norm_label: troubleshooting access is denied: batch logon and full admin token
nodes.rationale: Batch logon is not UAC-filtered, so an Administrators-group account keeps its full token; without 'Log on as a batch job' an interactive (filtered) logon is used.

nodes.label: DPAPI-encrypted saved password
nodes.rationale: Password never written to disk in plain text and only decryptable by the same Windows user account.
